profile.Name: Horse
profile.Personality: Restless and eager, always chasing the next rumor of treasure. He takes dangerous news as a reason to go, not a reason to stay away.
profile.Backstory: He has heard of a pillar of sand north of the Cannibal Plains, guarded by a monster and full of ancient technology, and wants to find it.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Excited about anything that sounds dangerous; brings up the sand pillar often.
